about: Cabinet outlines recoloured from cabinet.png (exported from cabinet.ase) by `bun run art` (scripts/gen-cabinets.ts): the 8 px round the screen of its first frame. palette maps each source colour to its Sweetie-16 replacement: 1a1c2c screen, b13e53 body, 5d275d joystick base, ffcd75 marquee letters and ball, ef7d57 letter shadow (only the screen and body reach the outline). The bevel gives the screen's lip a shaded (top, left) and lit (bottom, right) edge.
